params.name: height
params.description: optional block height, defaults to current tip

params.name: amount
params.description: the source asset amount in 1e8 decimals

params.name: destination
params.description: the destination address, required to generate memo

params.name: refund_address
params.description: the refund address, refunds will be sent here if the swap fails

params.name: streaming_interval
params.description: the interval in which streaming swaps are swapped

params.name: streaming_quantity
params.description: the quantity of swaps within a streaming swap

params.name: tolerance_bps
params.description: the maximum basis points from the current feeless swap price to set the limit in the generated memo

params.name: liquidity_tolerance_bps
params.description: the maximum basis points of tolerance for pool price movements to set the limit in the generated memo

params.name: affiliate_bps
params.description: the affiliate fee in basis points

items.docs: Provide a quote estimate for the provided swap.
